scope: Permanent core/frozen-toolchain source guard, explicit live-graph CI coverage and a caching-preserving local sccache startup repair. Compiler/runtime implementations and core capabilities are unchanged.

rejects: computed, protected and type-only frozen imports
core lower.emit calls, copied lowerer aliases and computed lowerer members
allows: explicit vm.lower binding accessed only as functionGraph
live graph and owned backend imports
boundary.kind: Conservative lexical source-boundary check; not an arbitrary dynamic-code security proof.

liveGraphCoverage.sharedLaneBinding: .github/ci-coverage.json and existing workflow-coverage validator retain the fast-check shared lane.
liveGraphCoverage.localPolicy: Lanes changing the live graph/kernel interfaces run the shared lane and fixpoint before migration integration; frozen toolchain still shares those interfaces.

localSccacheFix.cause: Startup-notification Unix socket is created below TMPDIR even with TCP server endpoint; long task paths exceed macOS sun_path.
localSccacheFix.selection: Login profile sets RUSTC_WRAPPER to the wrapper only when unset; explicit overrides are preserved. Direct sccache on PATH remains the Homebrew executable in login shells.
localSccacheFix.originalSecondFailure: Actual child environment was not retained; recorded short TMPDIR does not explain it.
localSccacheFix.loginProfileBody:
# Keep sccache startup sockets below the macOS path limit.
if [ -z "${RUSTC_WRAPPER:-}" ] && [ -x "$HOME/.opencode/bin/sccache" ]; then
    export RUSTC_WRAPPER="$HOME/.opencode/bin/sccache"
fi

remaining: Checked module/function/capture/constant catalogs and graph image orchestration.
Every branch consumer migrated before deleting frozen adapters with Rust at the flip.
